The /api/vlx/ blob (793,236 B Base64) was NOT decrypted (it has the envelope's byte layout but opens with neither the live nor the field key) and is NOT integrated.
/api/vlxnew/ POST returns 'Invalid hash'; the hash format is undetermined; it is NOT integrated.
The keys (live and field) are no longer present in the new libgojni.so .rodata; they are still live but must be carried forward (env vars).
The dynamic qemu route to extract the new key is blocked (bionic vs glibc TLS layout).
The VLX .vlx file format was re-verified with the lote-18 sample only; no new v1.11.24.2 export was supplied.
